```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(irlba)
library(tidytext)
```

```{r}
load("../data/claims-clean.RData")
```

```{r}
claims_clean$bclass_num <- ifelse(
  claims_clean$bclass == "Relevant claim content",
  1L,
  0L
)

y <- claims_clean$bclass_num

drop_cols <- c(".id", "bclass", "bclass_num")
word_cols <- setdiff(colnames(claims_clean), drop_cols)

length(word_cols)
```

```{r}
X_words <- as.matrix(claims_clean[, word_cols])

dim(X_words)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)

K_words <- 50

word_pca <- prcomp_irlba(
  X_words,
  n = K_words,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

Z_words <- word_pca$x   # n x K_words matrix of word PCs

# Train/validation split
n <- nrow(Z_words)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.7 * n))
valid_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), train_idx)

train_df <- data.frame(
  y = y[train_idx],
  Z_words[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
)

valid_df <- data.frame(
  y = y[valid_idx],
  Z_words[valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
)

word_pcr_fit <- glm(
  y ~ .,
  data = train_df,
  family = binomial()
)

# Predicted probabilities and log-odds on validation
p_hat_stage1 <- predict(word_pcr_fit, newdata = valid_df, type = "response")
eta_stage1_all <- predict(word_pcr_fit, newdata = data.frame(y = y, Z_words), type = "link")

# Accuracy function
accuracy <- function(y_true, p_hat, threshold = 0.5) {
  y_pred <- ifelse(p_hat >= threshold, 1L, 0L)
  mean(y_pred == y_true)
}

acc_stage1 <- accuracy(y[valid_idx], p_hat_stage1)
```

```{r}
load("../data/claims-raw.RData")
```

```{r}
claims_text <- claims_raw %>%
  select(.id, text_tmp) %>%
  mutate(
    # Remove script and style blocks entirely (including their contents)
    text_clean = gsub("(?s)<script.*?</script>", " ", text_tmp, perl = TRUE),
    text_clean = gsub("(?s)<style.*?</style>", " ", text_clean, perl = TRUE),

    # Remove all remaining HTML tags like <p>, <div>, <span> etc.
    text_clean = gsub("<[^>]+>", " ", text_clean),

    # Remove HTML entities like &amp; &nbsp; etc (simple version)
    text_clean = gsub("&[a-zA-Z]+;", " ", text_clean),

    # Collapse multiple spaces/newlines into a single space
    text_clean = gsub("\\s+", " ", text_clean),

    # Trim leading/trailing spaces
    text_clean = trimws(text_clean)
  ) %>%
  select(.id, text = text_clean)

head(claims_text$text)
```
```{r}
bigrams_df <- claims_text %>%
  unnest_tokens(
    output = "bigram",
    input = text,
    token = "ngrams",
    n = 2
  )

data("stop_words")

bigrams_sep <- bigrams_df %>%
  separate(bigram, into = c("word1", "word2"), sep = " ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  filter(
    !word1 %in% stop_words$word,
    !word2 %in% stop_words$word
  )

# Count bigram frequencies per document
bigram_counts <- bigrams_sep %>%
  count(.id, bigram)

# Keep only the top N most common bigrams
topN <- 2000

top_bigrams <- bigram_counts %>%
  group_by(bigram) %>%
  summarise(n_total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN)

bigram_counts_filt <- bigram_counts %>%
  semi_join(top_bigrams, by = "bigram")

# Cast to sparse document–bigram matrix
bigram_dtm <- bigram_counts_filt %>%
  cast_sparse(row = .id, column = bigram, value = n)

# Reorder rows to match claims_clean$.id (same as X_words, y)
# IDs in cleaned (word) data and in bigram matrix
ids_clean  <- as.character(claims_clean$.id)
ids_bigram <- rownames(bigram_dtm)

# Keep only IDs that appear in BOTH
common_ids <- intersect(ids_clean, ids_bigram)

length(ids_clean)      # total docs in claims_clean
length(ids_bigram)     # docs that have ≥1 bigram
length(common_ids)     # docs we will actually use for later
# Indices for each side
idx_clean  <- match(common_ids, ids_clean)
idx_bigram <- match(common_ids, ids_bigram)

# Subset word-based objects and bigram matrix to the common docs
y_sub          <- y[idx_clean]
Z_words_sub    <- Z_words[idx_clean, , drop = FALSE]
eta_stage1_sub <- eta_stage1_all[idx_clean]
bigram_dtm_sub <- bigram_dtm[idx_bigram, , drop = FALSE]

dim(bigram_dtm_sub)
length(y_sub)
```
```{r}
stage1_df_sub <- data.frame(
  y = y_sub,
  Z_words_sub
)

set.seed(123)
train_idx1_sub <- sample(seq_len(n_sub), size = floor(0.7 * n_sub))
valid_idx1_sub <- setdiff(seq_len(n_sub), train_idx1_sub)

stage1_train_sub <- stage1_df_sub[train_idx1_sub, ]
stage1_valid_sub <- stage1_df_sub[valid_idx1_sub, ]

stage1_fit_sub <- glm(
  y ~ .,
  data = stage1_train_sub,
  family = binomial()
)

p_hat_stage1_sub <- predict(stage1_fit_sub, newdata = stage1_valid_sub, type = "response")

acc_stage1_sub <- accuracy(stage1_df_sub$y[valid_idx1_sub], p_hat_stage1_sub)

cat(sprintf("Stage 1 (words only, subset) accuracy:  %.3f\n", acc_stage1_sub))
cat(sprintf("Stage 2 (words + bigrams) accuracy:     %.3f\n", acc_stage2))
```


```{r}

# Number of bigram PCs
K_bigrams <- 15

bigram_pca <- irlba::prcomp_irlba(
  bigram_dtm_sub,
  n = K_bigrams,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

Z_bigrams <- bigram_pca$x  # 2082 x K_bigrams

# Clean any non-finite values in Z_bigrams (NA, Inf, -Inf) by setting them to 0
Z_bigrams[!is.finite(Z_bigrams)] <- 0

# Also clean eta_stage1_sub just in case
eta_stage1_sub_clean <- eta_stage1_sub
eta_stage1_sub_clean[!is.finite(eta_stage1_sub_clean)] <- 0

# Build combined design: Stage 1 log-odds + bigram PCs
stage2_df <- data.frame(
  y          = as.numeric(y_sub),
  eta_stage1 = as.numeric(eta_stage1_sub_clean),
  Z_bigrams
)

n_sub <- nrow(stage2_df)

set.seed(123)
train_idx_sub <- sample(seq_len(n_sub), size = floor(0.7 * n_sub))
valid_idx_sub <- setdiff(seq_len(n_sub), train_idx_sub)

stage2_train <- stage2_df[train_idx_sub, ]
stage2_valid <- stage2_df[valid_idx_sub, ]

# Debug prints to make sure things look sane
cat("nrow(stage2_train):", nrow(stage2_train), "\n")
cat("summary(stage2_train$y):\n")
print(summary(stage2_train$y))

stage2_fit <- glm(
  y ~ .,
  data = stage2_train,
  family = binomial()
)

# Predict on validation set
p_hat_stage2 <- predict(stage2_fit, newdata = stage2_valid, type = "response")

# Use the y from stage2_valid so it lines up with predictions
y_valid_stage2 <- stage2_valid$y

# reuse your accuracy() function
acc_stage2 <- accuracy(y_valid_stage2, p_hat_stage2)

acc_stage2
```
